class.name: OcgShapefixFace
class.brief_description: This operator allows to perform various fixes on face and its wires: fixes provided by ShapeFix_Wire, fixing orientation of wires, addition of natural bounds, fixing of missing seam edge, and detection and removal of null-area wires
class.description: ! This operator allows to perform various fixes on face ! and its wires: fixes provided by ShapeFix_Wire, ! fixing orientation of wires, addition of natural bounds, ! fixing of missing seam edge, ! and detection and removal of null-area wires

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty tool

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a tool and loads a face

method.name: ClearModes
method.description: Sets all modes to default

method.name: Init_1
method.description: Loads a whole face already created, with its wires, sense and location

method.name: Init_2
method.description: Starts the creation of the face By default it will be FORWARD, or REVERSED if <fwd> is False

method.name: Init_3
method.description: Starts the creation of the face By default it will be FORWARD, or REVERSED if <fwd> is False

method.name: SetMsgRegistrator
method.description: Sets message registrator

method.name: SetPrecision
method.description: Sets basic precision value (also to FixWireTool)

method.name: SetMinTolerance
method.description: Sets minimal allowed tolerance (also to FixWireTool)

method.name: SetMaxTolerance
method.description: Sets maximal allowed tolerance (also to FixWireTool)

method.name: FixWireMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying fixes of ShapeFix_Wire, by default True.

method.name: FixOrientationMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix orientation mode, by default True. If True, wires oriented to border limited square.

method.name: FixAddNaturalBoundMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the add natural bound mode. If true, natural boundary is added on faces that miss them. Default is False for faces with single wire (they are handled by FixOrientation in that case) and True for others.

method.name: FixMissingSeamMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix missing seam mode, by default True. If True, tries to insert seam is missed.

method.name: FixSmallAreaWireMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix small area wire mode, by default False. If True, drops small wires.

method.name: RemoveSmallAreaFaceMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the remove face with small area, by default False. If True, drops faces with small outer wires.

method.name: FixIntersectingWiresMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix intersecting wires mode by default True.

method.name: FixLoopWiresMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix loop wires mode by default True.

method.name: FixSplitFaceMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the fix split face mode by default True.

method.name: AutoCorrectPrecisionMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the auto-correct precision mode by default False.

method.name: FixPeriodicDegeneratedMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the activation flag for periodic degenerated fix. False by default.

method.name: Face
method.description: Returns a face which corresponds to the current state Warning: The finally produced face may be another one ... but with the same support

method.name: Result
method.description: Returns resulting shape (Face or Shell if split) To be used instead of Face() if FixMissingSeam involved

method.name: Add
method.description: Add a wire to current face using BRep_Builder. Wire is added without taking into account orientation of face (as if face were FORWARD).

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs all the fixes, depending on modes Function Status returns the status of last call to Perform() ShapeExtend_OK : face was OK, nothing done ShapeExtend_DONE1: some wires are fixed ShapeExtend_DONE2: orientation of wires fixed ShapeExtend_DONE3: missing seam added ShapeExtend_DONE4: small area wire removed ShapeExtend_DONE5: natural bounds added ShapeExtend_FAIL1: some fails during fixing wires ShapeExtend_FAIL2: cannot fix orientation of wires ShapeExtend_FAIL3: cannot add missing seam ShapeExtend_FAIL4: cannot remove small area wire

method.name: FixOrientation_1
method.description: Fixes orientation of wires on the face It tries to make all wires lie outside all others (according to orientation) by reversing orientation of some of them. If face lying on sphere or torus has single wire and AddNaturalBoundMode is True, that wire is not reversed in any case (supposing that natural bound will be added). Returns True if wires were reversed

method.name: FixOrientation_2
method.description: Fixes orientation of wires on the face It tries to make all wires lie outside all others (according to orientation) by reversing orientation of some of them. If face lying on sphere or torus has single wire and AddNaturalBoundMode is True, that wire is not reversed in any case (supposing that natural bound will be added). Returns True if wires were reversed OutWires return information about out wires + list of internal wires for each (for performing split face).

method.name: FixAddNaturalBound
method.description: Adds natural boundary on face if it is missing. Two cases are supported: - face has no wires - face lies on geometrically double-closed surface (sphere or torus) and none of wires is left-oriented Returns True if natural boundary was added

method.name: FixMissingSeam
method.description: Detects and fixes the special case when face on a closed surface is given by two wires closed in 3d but with gap in 2d. In that case it creates a new wire from the two, and adds a missing seam edge Returns True if missing seam was added

method.name: FixSmallAreaWire
method.description: Detects wires with small area (that is less than 100*Precision::PConfusion(). Removes these wires if they are internal. Returns : True if at least one small wire removed, False if does nothing.

method.name: FixLoopWire
method.description: Detects if wire has a loop and fixes this situation by splitting on the few parts. if wire has a loops and it was split Status was set to value ShapeExtend_DONE6.

method.name: FixIntersectingWires
method.description: Detects and fixes the special case when face has more than one wire and this wires have intersection point

method.name: FixWiresTwoCoincEdges
method.description: If wire contains two coincidence edges it must be removed Queries on status after Perform()

method.name: FixSplitFace
method.description: Split face if there are more than one out wire using inrormation after FixOrientation()

method.name: FixPeriodicDegenerated
method.description: Fixes topology for a specific case when face is composed by a single wire belting a periodic surface. In that case a degenerated edge is reconstructed in the degenerated pole of the surface. Initial wire gets consistent orientation. Must be used in couple and before FixMissingSeam routine

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status of last call to Perform() ShapeExtend_OK : face was OK, nothing done ShapeExtend_DONE1: some wires are fixed ShapeExtend_DONE2: orientation of wires fixed ShapeExtend_DONE3: missing seam added ShapeExtend_DONE4: small area wire removed ShapeExtend_DONE5: natural bounds added ShapeExtend_DONE8: face may be splited ShapeExtend_FAIL1: some fails during fixing wires ShapeExtend_FAIL2: cannot fix orientation of wires ShapeExtend_FAIL3: cannot add missing seam ShapeExtend_FAIL4: cannot remove small area wire

method.name: FixWireTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing wires.
